div.div: Reference flow vs deployed Reference: External sources -> Discovery & Deduplication Agent -> Kafka (validated_job_offers) -> worker agents -> Job Search DB / UI. Deployed: finder -> campaign.jobs -> apply-worker pool -> mongo-0 -> campaign-api, with campaign.jobs.dlq for poison messages. The reference names three specialist workers; the deployment runs one consumer group (apply-workers), so parallelism comes from the three partitions, not from three services. Kafka owns delivery, Mongo owns bookkeeping: the offset commits only after the Mongo write succeeds, and a redelivery declines the action.
